data.title: Solana Needs a 167% Rally to Reach Its All-Time High, While Ethereum Requires 97%. Which Will Get There First?
data.description: Ethereum and Solana are both deep in the red from their peaks, but one faces a dramatically harder climb back. The gap between their recovery paths reveals a surprising tension over which coin could reclaim its glory first.
